Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — QBR with AcmeCorp scheduled Wed 9am PT. Need slide deck + a short exec ask slide.
Priya (CS Ops): I uploaded a starter deck: https://drive.redwood/example/Acme_QBR_v1.pptx (please use comments)
Jordan (Success Eng): Onboarding status: 85% complete; two outstanding items: SSO testing + batch import errors. I'll own SSO and put notes into the deck.
Ethan (AE): FYI — renewal convo last week surfaced budget concerns. Risk = medium until we can show ROI.
Tom (RevOps): I can run a quick 6‑month ROI and cost-savings slide. Will need raw usage + cost by Tue morning.
Maya (CSM): Action items (quick):
- Priya: finalize slides + add exec ask (due Tue 12:00 PT)
- Jordan: SSO status + error summary for slides (due Tue 15:00 PT)
- Tom: ROI numbers & CSV (due Tue EOD)
- Ethan: draft renewal options & talking points (due Tue EOD)
Please add owners if missing.
Priya (CS Ops): Added a one-slide 'exec ask' template and speaker notes placeholder in the deck. :thumbsup:
Ethan (AE): I'll draft concession tiers but want to sync with Tom before finalizing numbers.
Ana (Customer): Quick note from our side — team still wants better latency on embeddings. Can we include a timeline for perf improvements in the QBR?
Jordan (Success Eng): Noted. I have perf traces and a short remediation timeline — will add a slide with expected milestones.
qbr-bot: Calendar invite created for Wed 9:00 PT — guests: Acme execs, Maya, Ethan, Tom, Priya, Jordan.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — I'll consolidate everything into a v2 deck and ping for a review slot Wed morning. If anyone misses a due date, flag here so I can adjust.
Ethan (AE): Heads-up — one Acme exec might push for a 30% discount ask. I'll surface that in the draft talking points.
Tom (RevOps): If that happens we should present usage-based alternatives (commit tiers + performance SLA). I'll prepare 2 comps.
Priya (CS Ops): Review link v2: https://drive.redwood/example/Acme_QBR_v2.pptx — comments enabled.
Maya (CSM): Final request: add final 'next steps & owners' slide at the end. I'll sketch it and then we can finalize.
Ana (Customer): Appreciate it — excited to see improvements. See you Wed. :wave:
